name: Being Left Out
overview: Scripture reveals that being left out can reflect both God's holy separation of His people for Himself and the painful experience of forsakenness. Leviticus 20:26 describes how God sets His people apart, severing them from others to be His own. Yet, when earthly relationships fail, as in Psalms 27:10, the Lord gathers and upholds those who are forsaken. The brokenhearted are comforted and healed by God’s Spirit, who brings liberty and restoration (Psalms 147:3; Isaiah 61:1). However, there is also a sobering warning in Matthew 24:41 and 25:41 of those who will be left behind and separated from Christ, emphasizing the eternal consequences of being excluded from His kingdom.
